title: Hybrid Architectures (Jamba / Zamba / Gemma-recurrent / Nemotron-H)
prompt: Compare **Hybrid Architectures (Jamba / Zamba / Gemma-recurrent / Nemotron-H)** that interleave Mamba/Linear Attention layers with a few full Softmax Attention layers (e.g., 7:1 ratio).
